definitions.name: Z2C.RUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 1 COLLECT V -1 DROP CONCAT SUB [ 'X' BIND 0 1 X 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN V GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: Input a Vector; leaves the Vector of maximal equal-value runs, each a Vector, in order (run ids from a cumulative count of value changes).

definitions.name: Z2C.REDUCE
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: Input a String of brackets; deletes adjacent () and [] pairs in six rounds (enough for twelve characters) and leaves the irreducible residue.

definitions.name: Z2C.RUNLEN
definitions.body: 0 [ 'LANE' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 LANE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Input a Vector of readings; leaves, per reading, the length of the NIL run ending there (0 for a present reading).

definitions.name: Z2C.REVENUE
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'OV' BIND OV 'qty' GET OV 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Input the orders Vector; leaves the sum of qty times price over the orders that carry a price.

definitions.name: Z2C.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE 'K' BIND K K [ 'SK' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET SK EQ ] FILTER [ 'qty' GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Input the orders Vector; leaves a Record from each sku to its summed qty, skus in order of first appearance.
